en: An astronaut weighing 120 pounds on Earth would weigh only 20 pounds on the Moon because lunar gravity is one-sixth of Earth's.
Sunlight takes exactly 8 minutes and 20 seconds to travel the 150 million kilometers from the Sun to Earth at the speed of light.
Sound waves travel about 4.3 times faster in water, at 1,480 meters per second, than they do through air at 343 meters per second.
A single lightning bolt can heat the surrounding air to 30,000 degrees Celsius, making it five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
Using a block and tackle system with four movable pulleys reduces the required lifting force to exactly one-quarter of the object's total weight.
The coefficient of kinetic friction for rubber tires on dry concrete is about 0.8, but drops to just 0.1 on wet ice.
A small neodymium rare-earth magnet can lift up to 1,000 times its own weight due to its exceptionally strong magnetic field.
Water has a high specific heat capacity, requiring exactly 4.18 joules of energy to raise the temperature of one gram by one degree Celsius.
A 1,000-kilogram car traveling at 10 meters per second possesses exactly 50,000 joules of kinetic energy according to the physics formula.
The human eye can only see electromagnetic radiation with wavelengths between 380 nanometers for violet light and 700 nanometers for red light.
A standard alkaline AA battery provides exactly 1.5 volts of electrical potential difference to power small devices like flashlights and remote controls.
A normal human conversation measures about 60 decibels, which is one million times less intense than the 120 decibels produced by a loud rock concert.
